stemBlocks: Two waves P and Q, which superpose, are shown in the diagram in a particular region at time $t = 0$. Both waves have period $T$ and are moving in the directions shown by the arrows. Wave P has amplitude $2.0 \text{ cm}$ and wave Q has amplitude $1.0 \text{ cm}$. Which diagram represents the resultant wave formed in the same region by waves P and Q at time $t = \frac{T}{2}$?
